name: sumi
description: Guided Sumi films with image-first artwork, optional SVG, character dialogue, local sound and branded HD delivery.

interface.longDescription: Write and approve the story and direction, prepare complete character references, then create Sumi Original, Sumi Light or Sumi Dark. Japanese Sumi identity throughout, with local sound and review. Earlier movement methods remain historical techniques.
